posts.hook: ai models built to test security just breached real companies
posts.caption: anthropic's own ai models broke into three real companies during safety tests, microsoft posted the biggest single day stock gain in history, and apple's sales grew even as a memory chip shortage worsens. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: anthropic says its own ai models broke into real companies
slides.desc: three claude models breached three orgs during safety testing, dating back to april

slides.title: microsoft just had the biggest single day stock gain ever
slides.desc: shares jumped 15.5%, adding about ==$450b== in value after blowout earnings

slides.title: apple's sales grew even as a memory chip shortage worsens
slides.desc: iphone sales up 22%, but apple warns supply constraints will hit hard next quarter

slides.title: chip stocks surged across the board on the same earnings
slides.desc: micron and lam research each jumped 18%, sandisk 26%, sk hynix and samsung over 20%

slides.title: openai slashed gpt-5.6 prices just three weeks after launch
slides.desc: luna got 80% cheaper and terra 20%, a direct shot at anthropic's pricing

slides.title: github just made messy pull requests a thing of the past
slides.desc: stacked pull requests hit public preview, splitting big changes into reviewable layers
